name: Meta-Frameworks & SSR
description: Full-stack frontend meta-frameworks: Next.js, Nuxt 3, server-side rendering concepts, static site generation, React Server Components, data fetching patterns, edge runtime, SEO/meta management, and deployment platforms.

subskills.name: Next.js
subskills.description: App Router vs Pages Router, file-based routing, API routes, middleware, SSR/SSG/ISR rendering modes.

subskills.name: Nuxt 3
subskills.description: Nuxt 3 auto-imports, server routes (/server/api), useFetch, Nitro engine, modules.

subskills.name: SSR Concepts
subskills.description: Server-side rendering lifecycle, hydration, hydration mismatch errors, streaming SSR, selective hydration.

subskills.name: Static Site Generation
subskills.description: SSG build-time rendering, Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR), fallback pages, revalidation.

subskills.name: React Server Components
subskills.description: RSC architecture, server/client component boundary, 'use client' / 'use server' directives, serialization constraints.

subskills.name: Data Fetching Patterns
subskills.description: Server-side fetching, SWR/React Query for client cache, loader patterns, waterfall prevention.

subskills.name: Edge Runtime
subskills.description: Edge functions, Vercel Edge Middleware, Cloudflare Workers compatibility, cold start optimization.

subskills.name: SEO & Meta Management
subskills.description: Head management (next/head, useHead), Open Graph tags, structured data (JSON-LD), sitemap generation.

subskills.name: Deployment Platforms
subskills.description: Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, Docker containerization for SSR apps, preview deployments.

github.signal: Server Components or use client/use server directives
SEO meta tags or structured data

cv.signal: Next.js or Nuxt development in production

linkedin.signal: SSR, SEO, or Vercel experience mentioned
Server Components or Edge Functions mentioned

junior.description: Builds pages with Next.js, implements SSG for content sites, and manages SEO meta tags.

mid.description: Understands SSR lifecycle and hydration, implements efficient data fetching patterns, and works across meta-frameworks.

senior.description: Architects RSC boundaries, leverages edge runtime for latency-critical paths, and designs deployment strategies.
